title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-admission campus activities and spaces with free-access evidence from Stevenson University.

cards.title: Browse the Academic Center Gallery
cards.subtitle: Kevin J. Manning Academic Center, Owings Mills North
cards.notes: Stop by the second-floor concourse to view the current exhibition; confirm gallery hours before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A naturally lit, university gallery in the Manning Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson states gallery admission is free and open to all; this gallery is on the Academic Center’s second-floor concourse.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to all. Listed hours: Monday–Friday 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; Saturday 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Look through the School of Design Gallery
cards.subtitle: School of Design, Owings Mills North
cards.notes: Use the atrium-adjacent gallery for a short art break, then check the exhibitions page for the current display.
cards.short_summary: A flexible gallery for design-focused exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson states gallery admission is free and open to all, and identifies the School of Design Gallery as an exhibition venue.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to all. Listed hours: Monday–Friday 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; Saturday 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Visit the Greenspring Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Dawson Center, Greenspring Campus
cards.notes: Take the campus shuttle or arrange a visit to see the Dawson Center gallery’s current exhibition and any listed talks.
cards.short_summary: Stevenson’s original dedicated gallery space at Greenspring.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson states gallery admission is free and open to all; the Art Gallery is located in the Dawson Center on the Greenspring campus.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to all. Listed hours: Monday–Friday 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; Saturday 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Catch a MAP movie
cards.subtitle: Mustang Activities and Programming Board programming
cards.notes: Watch Student Life announcements for the next screening, then go with friends; the university lists MAP entertainment as free.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus movie series programmed by MAP.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says MAP brings free entertainment to campus and books a monthly movie series.
cards.access_notes: Availability, venue, and schedule vary by event; check Student Life programming updates.

cards.title: See a MAP musician
cards.subtitle: Mustang Activities and Programming Board programming
cards.notes: Check upcoming Student Life programming for a musician booking and invite a friend; no purchase is required for MAP entertainment.
cards.short_summary: Free campus music appearances presented through MAP.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says MAP brings free entertainment to campus, including musicians.
cards.access_notes: Artist, location, and date vary by event; consult current Student Life notices.

cards.title: Go to a MAP comedy event
cards.subtitle: Mustang Activities and Programming Board programming
cards.notes: Look for a MAP comedian on the Student Life calendar and arrive according to the event’s posted entry guidance.
cards.short_summary: Campus comedy programming offered through MAP.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says MAP brings free entertainment to campus, including comedians.
cards.access_notes: Event timing and venue vary; use current Student Life announcements for details.

cards.title: Hear a MAP speaker
cards.subtitle: Mustang Activities and Programming Board programming
cards.notes: Choose a speaker event that fits your interests, then check the event listing for location and any attendance instructions.
cards.short_summary: Free speaker appearances booked by MAP.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says MAP brings free entertainment to campus, including speakers.
cards.access_notes: Speaker topics, dates, and locations vary by program; check current event information.

cards.title: Try a MAP novelty event
cards.subtitle: Mustang Activities and Programming Board programming
cards.notes: Check Student Life announcements for the next MAP novelty program; bring friends and follow any posted capacity guidance.
cards.short_summary: Free special-event programming coordinated by MAP.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says MAP brings free entertainment to campus, including novelties.
cards.access_notes: Specific activity, venue, and capacity vary by program; see current Student Life updates.

cards.title: Work out at Caves Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Caves Sports & Wellness Center, Owings Mills
cards.notes: Reserve a slot through campus recreation, then use the center during its posted hours for a no-extra-charge active hang.
cards.short_summary: A reservable campus fitness center in the Caves building.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson’s catalog describes its Owings Mills fitness centers as free of charge for students, faculty, staff, and alumni; the current Student Life page identifies Caves Fitness Center.
cards.access_notes: Current Student Life information says reservations are required and the center is open to students, faculty, and staff; verify the reservation schedule before going.

cards.title: Move together at Garrison Hall North Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Garrison Hall Student Activities Commons, Owings Mills
cards.notes: Make the required reservation and plan a short workout with a friend during the center’s currently posted open hours.
cards.short_summary: A reservable fitness center in Garrison Hall’s student activities area.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson’s catalog describes its Owings Mills fitness centers as free of charge for students, faculty, staff, and alumni; the current Student Life page identifies Garrison Hall North Fitness Center.
cards.access_notes: Current Student Life information says reservations are required and the center is open to students, faculty, and staff; verify current hours before going.

warnings: Fitness-center no-charge evidence is from Stevenson’s publicly posted undergraduate catalog; confirm current recreation policies when reserving.
